difficulty_reason: Let g : Y' -> Y be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes and let f : X -> Y be proper, flat and of finite presentation; the lemma asserts that the base change map (equation-base-change-map) is an isomorphism for all K in D_QCoh(O_Y) (statement lines 2928-2934). The proof uses Lemma labelled lemma-proper-flat-relative to know that the formation of a and a' commutes with restriction to opens of Y and Y', reducing the assertion to the case where Y' -> Y is a morphism of affine schemes by Remark labelled remark-check-over-affines, where it becomes Lemma labelled lemma-more-base-change (proof lines 2936-2942). Gluing the base change map from open pieces so that only the affine case remains is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
